subject: Donald Trump and Iran as well resolving straight of Hormuz
assessment: ANALYSIS: The primary bottlenecks in resolving the Strait of Hormuz issue under the presidency of Donald Trump and dealings with Iran include geopolitical tensions, historical conflicts, and the complexities of international maritime law. RESOLUTION: A multi-faceted approach involving diplomatic negotiations, economic incentives, and strategic military planning could alleviate tensions. DISPATCH: Creative (Diplomacy), Technical (Maritime Law), Operational (Military Strategy), Labor (International Cooperation), Intellectual (Economic Analysis) -> Global Avenues such as the United Nations, International Maritime Organization, and bilateral diplomatic channels.
